documents.observation: CLI accepts wheel paths, prefix/staging controls, explicit no-bytecode and RECORD-validation options; validation defaults to none and bytecode defaults to levels0,1. Existing-file overwrite is opt-in.

documents.observation: WheelFile.validate_record(validate_contents=True) checks RECORD membership plus content sizes/hashes. The documentation tells callers to validate before installation.

documents.title: installer.destinations
documents.short_quote: Hashes the written content, to determine the entry in the RECORD file.
documents.observation: Destination methods support file/script writing and final RECORD output. SchemeDictionaryDestination exposes SHA256 hashing, empty bytecode-level defaults and no-overwrite behavior.
documents.claim_scope: Documented output responsibilities; not path-race confinement, quotas, atomicity, durability or no-execution certification.
